_note: Shape thresholds and per-pattern weights (relative conviction, not probabilities - tune these as you see how often each pattern matters in practice). Scale-invariant (body_pct etc. are ratios), so one set of numbers works across daily/weekly/monthly.

spinning_top._note: 2026-10-29, see trader/core/candlestick.py's _spinning_top docstring. Partitions the small-body space with doji (above) and hammer_family (below): body_pct > doji.max_body_pct and <= this max_body_pct, AND neither shadow is >= hammer_family.min_long_shadow_ratio times the other (that asymmetric case belongs to hammer_family instead).

hammer_family._note: Shared by hammer/hanging_man/shooting_star/inverted_hammer - same shape, trend context picks the label.

piercing_dark_cloud._note: require_gap=false is more practical for resampled weekly/monthly bars and less-liquid names where a clean gap beyond the prior high/low is rare; set true for strict textbook matching.
